Name: Bits 'n' Bobs (Now in Technicolor)
Author: fruitipebbles
Description:
[font=Courier New]Bits 'n' Bobs adds six new hats via Json Assets and revamps the accessories tray! I made this because I wanted accessories that look good on any skin tone, not just the lighter ones. Then I added hair clips, because I will never have enough hair clips.

[b]Now in Technicolor:[/b]

This update to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8317]Bit 'n' Bobs[/url] is big enough to warrant its own mod because it adds [b]six new colorways[/b] as well as additional [b]blush[/b] overlays which makes it possible to mix and match accessories.

Want both mascara and blush? Not a problem. Want to match your shirt to your shoes and your shoes to your hairclip? Again, not a problem.

[size=1]note: You can still download the original Bits 'n' Bobs [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8317]here[/url]! As this mod adds onto the existing Bits 'n' Bobs, they will conflict if they're both installed. No worries! Just make sure to have one or the other.[/size]

[b]Hats:[/b]
Glasses 
﻿Butterfly Clips
﻿Claw Clip
﻿Studs
﻿Hoops
﻿Cross Earrings


[b]Accessories:[/b]
﻿1: Default
﻿2-4: Matches eye color to hair.
﻿4-6: Matches eyebrows/eyelashes to hair
﻿7: Black eyelashes/eyebrows
﻿8: Band-aid on the nose
﻿9-11: Heterochromia–blue, green, and purple
﻿12-15: Blush, slightly translucent to better match with skin tone.
﻿16-19: Lipstick/gloss, slightly translucent to better match with skin tone.

[b]installation:[/b]

Requires: SMAPI, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] & [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720]Json Assets[/url]. Non-negotiable.
Recommended: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4734]Customize Anywhere[/url] / [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5044]Get Glam[/url] / [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/93]CJB Item Spawner[/url]
Put it in your mods folder and start the game to generate a config file.
There you have four options:

﻿Color, which determines the color of the hats.
﻿ [b]﻿Black, Gold, Silver, Red, Pink, Yellow, Green, Blue & Purple[/b]
﻿Blush, toggle the blush overlay.
﻿ [b]﻿True & False[/b]
[i] ﻿If Blush is enabled:[/i]
﻿Shade, the brightness of the blush.
﻿ ﻿[b]Fair, Medium & Deep[/b]
﻿Undertone, the hue of the blush.
﻿ [b]﻿Warm & Cool[/b][/font][b][font=Courier New]
[/font][/b][font=Courier New][size=1]
[/size][/font][font=Courier New][size=1]note: These config options only affect the colorway of the hats added by Json Assets as well as the toggle-able blush overlay. The accessories are identical across the board.[/size][/font]
[font=Courier New]
You can spawn in the hat via one of the "recommended mods" linked above or you can buy them from the hat mouse as usual. Okay, poke?
